concatenation: paste0(prompt, generation); no separator, trimming or normalization

anonymization_policy.scope: Full prompt plus continuation, domain-specific dictionary; original text preserved
anonymization_policy.matching: Case-insensitive whole aliases with Unicode letter/number boundaries, longest first
anonymization_policy.source: BOLD original prompt subjects and explicit config, never generated text
anonymization_policy.person_names: Known full names in gender/race; configured shortened aliases scoped by subject
anonymization_policy.other_domains: Identifying role/religion/ideology terms, not arbitrary page titles
anonymization_policy.limitation: Dictionary masking is not exhaustive entity recognition or a verified exact reproduction of BOLD preprocessing
anonymization_policy.scoring_gate: eligible_anonymized_metrics: Han screen AND applied AND no outstanding automatic review flag

language_policy.scope: Original generation only; Unicode script=Han from audit_has_han
language_policy.eligible: Prepared text and no Han in generation
language_policy.excluded_scores_policy: Future scorers must retain NA for excluded rows, never zero
